Title: AdditionalMessageContent - Named KernelContent Wrapper
Summary: Named wrapper for KernelContent used to attach additional content items (images, files) to chat messages.
Content:
## AdditionalMessageContent

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Named wrapper for `Microsoft.SemanticKernel.KernelContent`. Used to attach additional content items (images, files, etc.) to chat messages.

### Constructor
```csharp
public AdditionalMessageContent(string name, KernelContent item)
```

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Name` | `string` | Display name of the content item (e.g., filename) |
| `Item` | `KernelContent` | The underlying Semantic Kernel content |

### Usage
```csharp
// Create an image content item
var imageContent = new ImageContent(imageBytes, "image/png");
var additionalContent = new AdditionalMessageContent("screenshot.png", imageContent);

// Add to chat message
await chatMessageService.AddMessage(AuthorRole.User, "Analyze this image", additionalContent);

// Or use in queued input
var input = new QueuedInput(AuthorRole.User, "Analyze this", new[] { additionalContent });
```

### Related
- `IFileHandler` - Creates AdditionalMessageContent from files
- `IFileHandlerFactory` - Aggregates file handlers
- `QueuedInput` - Contains a list of AdditionalMessageContent
- `IChatMessageService` - Accepts AdditionalMessageContent in AddMessage
